description: Splectrum vocabulary for horizontal meaning consistency

api.description: container type for a managed, stacked, self-contained unit; can have multiple apiFacets

apiFacet.description: a collection of methods within an api; maps to common understanding of API

container.description: envelope around a data structure, can be code; the most elementary building block in splectrum

debug.description: conventional flag for maximum output; maps to enriched

detail.description: full description; mainly used in metadata

dryRun.description: show execution plan without applying state changes

enriched.description: full content plus context (DSL lookups, cross-references); maximum output level

extends.description: adds to an existing type, typically a container type

failFast.description: abort a process at earliest error occurrence

faf.description: fire and forget, to save a data state record typically async

facet.description: an aspect of, used extensively in splectrum (e.g. apiFacet)

freetext.description: natural language output (vs structured data output)

handler.description: functional implementation; can be script, formal method, or informal method at API, package, or module level

headers.description: section of metadata (e.g. in Kafka record)

instantiates.description: create an instance of, typically a container type

major.description: 1st part of version; for disruptive upgrades

method.description: handler that is a member of an apiFacet of a Splectrum API

metaoutput.description: metadata that accompanies output data, in splectrum a continuous stream alongside data

minor.description: 2nd part of version; for non-disruptive upgrades

nopac.description: no prompt and confirm; no dryRun prior to execution

overlay.description: putting one structure on top of another, creating a layered stack

pac.description: prompt with dryRun to confirm execution

patch.description: 3rd part of version; for minor fixes

prXX.description: used as package name for project associated code or data

record.description: Kafka-style message structure; native internal data structure

report.description: structured data set; written account of state

runtime.description: the context in which a process executes

runtimeId.description: unique identifier of an execution context

schema.description: description of (data) structure; Splectrum uses AVRO format

selfeval.description: universal API method for self testing against requirements, available on all containers

silent.description: conventional flag for suppressed output; maps to topline

summary.description: compact description; mainly used in metadata

topline.description: title-style summary; mainly used in metadata

typeof.description: the top level type, typically of a container

verbose.description: conventional flag for expanded output; maps to detail

version.description: unique identifier of a code or data unit; typically format v1.0.0

whoami.description: universal API method for introspection, available on all containers
